ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a right triangle, with vertex C at the lower left, vertex B at the lower right, and vertex A at the upper right; there is a right-angle mark at B. Side CB is labeled 20, side BA is labeled 15, and hypotenuse CA is labeled 25. It asks to find tan C and convert it to the decimal closest to the hundredth place. For angle C, tangent equals the opposite side divided by the adjacent side. The opposite side of angle C is BA = 15, and the adjacent side is CB = 20, so tan C = 15/20 = 0.75. Rounded to the nearest hundredth, it is still 0.75.
